WITH contest_info AS ( SELECT id, start_time, end_time FROM contest WHERE id = #{contestId} ), -- 只带赛时内提交，尽早过滤 jc AS ( SELECT j.* FROM judge j JOIN contest_info c ON j.contest_id = c.id WHERE j.created_time BETWEEN c.start_time AND c.end_time AND j.contest_id = #{contestId} ), -- 每个用户每题的第一次 AC 时间（赛时内） first_ac AS ( SELECT user_id, display_id, MIN(created_time) AS first_ac_time FROM jc WHERE status = 0 GROUP BY user_id, display_id ), -- 每题全场最早 AC（用于判断 isFirstAC） first_ac_global AS ( SELECT display_id, MIN(first_ac_time) AS first_ac_time FROM first_ac GROUP BY display_id ), -- 错误次数统计：排除等待及执行中状态，重评期间不增加错误次数 error_cnt AS ( SELECT j.user_id, j.display_id, SUM(CASE WHEN fa.first_ac_time IS NULL THEN (CASE WHEN j.status NOT IN (0, 5, 6, 7, 9) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) WHEN j.status NOT IN (0, 5, 6, 7, 9) AND j.created_time < fa.first_ac_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error_num FROM jc j LEFT JOIN first_ac fa ON fa.user_id = j.user_id AND fa.display_id = j.display_id GROUP BY j.user_id, j.display_id ), -- 合并用户-题信息：AC 的记录 per_problem_ac AS ( SELECT fa.user_id, fa.display_id, 1 AS is_ac, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, ci.start_time, fa.first_ac_time) AS ac_time, COALESCE(ec.error_num, 0) AS error_num, CASE WHEN fa.first_ac_time = fag.first_ac_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_first_ac FROM first_ac fa JOIN contest_info ci ON TRUE LEFT JOIN error_cnt ec ON ec.user_id = fa.user_id AND ec.display_id = fa.display_id LEFT JOIN first_ac_global fag ON fag.display_id = fa.display_id ), -- 合并用户-题信息：仅错题（无 AC） per_problem_nonac AS ( SELECT ec.user_id, ec.display_id, 0 AS is_ac, NULL AS ac_time, ec.error_num, 0 AS is_first_ac FROM error_cnt ec LEFT JOIN first_ac fa ON fa.user_id = ec.user_id AND fa.display_id = ec.display_id WHERE fa.user_id IS NULL ), all_problem AS ( SELECT * FROM per_problem_ac UNION ALL SELECT * FROM per_problem_nonac ), -- 只包含本场有提交的用户 users_with_subs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM jc ), -- 汇总每位用户：ac 数、总罚时（秒）、提交次数 user_summary AS ( SELECT u.user_id, COALESCE(SUM(ap.is_ac), 0) AS ac, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN ap.is_ac = 1 THEN (COALESCE(ap.ac_time,0) + ap.error_num * 1200) ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS total_time, COALESCE(subs.sub_count, 0) AS total_submissions FROM users_with_subs u LEFT JOIN all_problem ap ON ap.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS sub_count FROM jc GROUP BY user_id ) subs ON subs.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id ), ranked AS ( SELECT us.user_id, us.ac, us.total_time, us.total_submissions, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY us.ac DESC, us.total_time ASC, us.user_id ASC) AS rank_num FROM user_summary us ) SELECT r.rank_num AS `rank`, u.id AS uid, u.username, u.nickname, u.school, r.ac, r.total_time, r.total_submissions AS `total`, COALESCE( JSON_OBJECTAGG( ap.display_id, JSON_OBJECT( 'errorNum', ap.error_num, 'isAC', ap.is_ac, 'actime', ap.ac_time, 'isFirstAC', ap.is_first_ac ) ), JSON_OBJECT() ) AS submission_info FROM ranked r JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN all_problem ap ON ap.user_id = r.user_id
u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.school LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY r.rank_num, u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.school, r.ac, r.total_time, r.total_submissions ORDER BY r.rank_num

WITH contest_info AS ( SELECT id, start_time, end_time FROM contest WHERE id = #{contestId} ), -- 只带赛时内提交，尽早过滤 jc AS ( SELECT j.* FROM judge j JOIN contest_info c ON j.contest_id = c.id WHERE j.created_time BETWEEN c.start_time AND c.end_time AND j.contest_id = #{contestId} ), -- 每位用户每题的最高分（仅基于赛时内提交） max_score_per AS ( SELECT user_id, display_id, COALESCE(MAX(score), 0) AS score FROM jc GROUP BY user_id, display_id ), -- 每个用户每题的第一次 AC 时间（赛时内） first_ac AS ( SELECT user_id, display_id, MIN(created_time) AS first_ac_time FROM jc WHERE status = 0 GROUP BY user_id, display_id ), -- 每题全场最早 AC（用于判断 isFirstAC） first_ac_global AS ( SELECT display_id, MIN(first_ac_time) AS first_ac_time FROM first_ac GROUP BY display_id ), -- 错误次数统计：排除等待及执行中状态，重评期间不增加错误次数 error_cnt AS ( SELECT j.user_id, j.display_id, SUM(CASE WHEN fa.first_ac_time IS NULL THEN (CASE WHEN j.status NOT IN (0, 5, 6, 7, 9) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) WHEN j.status NOT IN (0, 5, 6, 7, 9) AND j.created_time < fa.first_ac_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error_num FROM jc j LEFT JOIN first_ac fa ON fa.user_id = j.user_id AND fa.display_id = j.display_id GROUP BY j.user_id, j.display_id ), -- 合并用户-题信息：AC 的记录（增加 score） per_problem_ac AS ( SELECT fa.user_id, fa.display_id, 1 AS is_ac, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, ci.start_time, fa.first_ac_time) AS ac_time, COALESCE(ec.error_num, 0) AS error_num, CASE WHEN fa.first_ac_time = fag.first_ac_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_first_ac, COALESCE(ms.score, 0) AS score FROM first_ac fa JOIN contest_info ci ON TRUE LEFT JOIN error_cnt ec ON ec.user_id = fa.user_id AND ec.display_id = fa.display_id LEFT JOIN first_ac_global fag ON fag.display_id = fa.display_id LEFT JOIN max_score_per ms ON ms.user_id = fa.user_id AND ms.display_id = fa.display_id ), -- 合并用户-题信息：仅错题（无 AC）——增加 score（多数为 0，但若有分数也保留） per_problem_nonac AS ( SELECT ec.user_id, ec.display_id, 0 AS is_ac, NULL AS ac_time, ec.error_num, 0 AS is_first_ac, COALESCE(ms.score, 0) AS score FROM error_cnt ec LEFT JOIN first_ac fa ON fa.user_id = ec.user_id AND fa.display_id = ec.display_id LEFT JOIN max_score_per ms ON ms.user_id = ec.user_id AND ms.display_id = ec.display_id WHERE fa.user_id IS NULL ), all_problem AS ( SELECT * FROM per_problem_ac UNION ALL SELECT * FROM per_problem_nonac ), -- 只包含本场有提交的用户 users_with_subs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM jc ), -- 汇总每位用户：ac 数、总罚时（秒）、提交次数，并新增 total_score（OI） user_summary AS ( SELECT u.user_id, COALESCE(SUM(ap.is_ac), 0) AS ac, COALESCE(SUM(ap.score), 0) AS total_score, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN ap.is_ac = 1 THEN (COALESCE(ap.ac_time,0) + ap.error_num * 1200) ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS total_time, COALESCE(subs.sub_count, 0) AS total_submissions FROM users_with_subs u LEFT JOIN all_problem ap ON ap.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS sub_count FROM jc GROUP BY user_id ) subs ON subs.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id ), -- 排名：按 OI 规则 total_score DESC -> ac DESC -> total_time ASC ranked AS ( SELECT us.user_id, us.ac, us.total_score, us.total_time, us.total_submissions, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY us.total_score DESC, us.ac DESC, us.total_time, us.user_id ) AS rank_num FROM user_summary us ) SELECT r.rank_num AS `rank`, u.id AS uid, u.username, u.nickname, u.school, r.total_score, r.ac, r.total_time, r.total_submissions AS `total`, COALESCE( JSON_OBJECTAGG( ap.display_id, JSON_OBJECT( 'errorNum', ap.error_num, 'isAC', ap.is_ac, 'actime', ap.ac_time, 'isFirstAC', ap.is_first_ac, 'score', ap.score ) ), JSON_OBJECT() ) AS submission_info FROM ranked r JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN all_problem ap ON ap.user_id = r.user_id
u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.school LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY r.rank_num, u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.school, r.total_score, r.ac, r.total_time, r.total_submissions ORDER BY r.rank_num
